justification: The package has 21 direct Java classes totaling 3,302 LOC (e.g. `CaptureActivity.java` 768 lines, `Intents.java` 304, `DecodeHintManager.java` 234, `HttpHelper.java` 215, `CaptureActivityHandler.java` 169). The inspected files show it centralizes many unrelated responsibilities in one package: camera/scan UI and state machine (`CaptureActivity.java`, `CaptureActivityHandler.java`), intent/API constants (`Intents.java`), decoding-hint parsing (`DecodeHintManager.java`), preferences UI (`PreferencesFragment.java`), audio/vibration (`BeepManager.java`), HTTP utilities (`HttpHelper.java`), lifecycle/light/locale helpers (`InactivityTimer.java`, `AmbientLightManager.java`, `LocaleManager.java`), and support activities like `HelpActivity.java` and `PreferencesActivity.java`, which is consistent with a God Component.
